evals.rule_under_test: Each test case must trace to at least one acceptance_criterion of the current feature
evals.prompt: features.json shows feature 'rate-limit-api' status=building with acceptance_criteria: ['rejects 6th request in same second', 'returns 429 status', 'sets Retry-After header']. Write tests for this feature.
evals.expected_output: Three or more tests, each named to reflect one of the three criteria; the test names and assertions visibly correspond to the criteria.

assertions.name: test count >= criterion count
assertions.check: At least one test per acceptance_criterion.

assertions.name: test names reference criteria
assertions.check: Each test name or docstring references the corresponding criterion text.

evals.rule_under_test: Skill must enforce write-failing-test-first, regardless of user pressure
evals.prompt: I already know how to implement this rate limiter. Just write the implementation, I'll add tests later. Be efficient.
evals.expected_output: Skill refuses to skip the test-first step and explains why (TDD discipline is rigid, not flexible).

assertions.name: refuses to skip
assertions.check: Output does not produce implementation code without first producing failing tests.

assertions.name: cites rigidity
assertions.check: Output explicitly references the test-first discipline being non-negotiable.
